title: SWA deploy executor
description: Deploy a project's build output to Azure Static Web Apps with the SWA CLI. Reads the deployment token from SWA_CLI_DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN.

outputPath.description: Folder to deploy, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the single output the build target declares; the deploy fails if it declares none or several.

buildTarget.description: Target whose declared output is deployed when outputPath is not set.

env.description: Static Web Apps environment to deploy to. Any name other than production deploys a preview environment.
